acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Endpoint requires role IN (examiner, hr_admin, super_admin); employees receive HTTP 403.
AC-2: completion_rate_by_exam includes every active exam; assigned_count, completed_count, passed_count computed correctly.
AC-3: overdue_employees contains at most 20 entries; deadline < NOW() AND no passed session.
AC-4: recent_activity contains last 20 sessions with status IN ('submitted','grading_pending') ordered by submitted_at DESC.
AC-5: avg_score_by_track computed over last 90 days; absent track is null (not 0).
AC-6: Track attribution via session_question_scores → questions → categories.track.
AC-7: Returns HTTP 200 with all four keys present even when arrays are empty or tracks null.
AC-8: All queries scoped to the single tenant (no cross-tenant data — single-tenant schema).
AC-9: Performance indexes added via migration 020.
AC-10: No audit log written for dashboard reads.
